Raise tail headroom with a higher gm/Id mirror, lower the Sallen-Key cap to reduce the buffer load, expose fc_t as a tunable knob, and correct the power units."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (18.0, 16.0, 24.0),        # NMOS pair gm/Id [S/A]
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),           # pair length [um]
    "Id_pair": (30e-6, 15e-6, 32e-6),     # per-branch current; tail = 2*Id_pair
    "C":       (0.25e-12, 0.1e-12, 0.5e-12),  # SK capacitor C1 (C2 device = C + cgg)
    "gmid_p":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),         # PMOS mirror load gm/Id [S/A]
    "gmid_t":  (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),        # reference/tail mirror gm/Id (shared, L=1 um)
    "fc_t":    (1.8e6, 1.3e6, 2.6e6),     # SK design target frequency [Hz]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-12)
    Id = p["Id_pair"]
    C = p["C"]
    fc_t = p["fc_t"]

    # Reference and tail mirror: same L and gm/Id (higher gm/Id -> lower Vdsat -> more tail headroom)
    ref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)
    tail = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], 1.0, 2 * Id, vds=0.25)

    # Matched NMOS pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Id, vds=0.4)

    # PMOS mirror load (diode M3, output M4 same size)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], 1.0, Id, vds=1.1)

    # Sallen-Key unity-gain lowpass: C2 = C + parasitic cgg of M1
    C2e = C + m1.cgg
    R = 1.0 / (2 * PI * fc_t * math.sqrt(C * C2e))
    Q = 0.5 * math.sqrt(C / C2e)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ref)     # reference sink
    n.dev("Mt", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", tail)     # tail source
    # Non-inverting input at gate of M1 (node b); inverting feedback from vout at gate of M2
    n.dev("M1", "left", "b", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vout", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "left", "left", "vdd", "vdd", m3)        # diode load
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "left", "vdd", "vdd", m3)        # mirror output

    # Sallen-Key: vin -R1- a -R2- b, C1 a->vout, C2 b->vss
    n.R("R1", "vin", "a", R)
    n.R("R2", "a", "b", R)
    n.C("C1", "a", "vout", C)
    n.C("C2", "b", "vss", C)

    x = 10.0
    mag_stop = 1.0 / math.sqrt((1 - x * x) ** 2 + (x / Q) ** 2)
    atten = -db(mag_stop)
    if Q > 1.0 / math.sqrt(2.0):
        peak = db(Q / math.sqrt(1.0 - 1.0 / (4.0 * Q * Q)))
    else:
        peak = 0.0
    i_total = iref + 2 * Id
    pred = {
        "gain_db": db(1.0),
        "fc": fc_t,
        "atten_db": atten,
        "peaking_db": peak,
        "f0": fc_t,
        "q": Q,
        "power": 1.8 * i_total,   # W (was mis-scaled by 1e6 before)
    }
    return n, pred
```
